meta.name: Ek Thi Begum Hindi 720p
meta.description:
After Zaheer’s altercation with the Maqsood gang and the killing of Raghu Mhatre, member of the gang and brother of Nana Mhatre, leaves Zaheer and Ashraf in terrible danger and looking over their back constantly, a ray of hope enters their lives in the form of the amazing news of Ashraf’s pregnancy. After the news of a new member of the family to soon join Zaheer and Ashraf brings happiness in their lives, they decide to celebrate the news and the new arrival. The celebrations take a nasty turn when Zaheer and Ashraf get on the receiving end of an unexpected attack from the Nana Mhatre gang. They both manage to escape and survive with very little margin for error and that leads to Zaheer taking the bold and difficult decision to quit underworld once and for all, for the safety of his family and his unborn child.

Ended · First aired 8 Apr 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: MX Player · Network: MX Player

videos.title: The Big Mistake
videos.overview: The animosity between Maqsood gang and Zaheer Bhatkar takes an ugly turn when Raghu Mhatre, a daring gangster of Maqsood gang and most importantly brother of Nana Mhatre gets killed in a shootout with Zaheer Bhatkar.

videos.title: The Turning Point
videos.overview: The news of Ashraf's pregnancy brings happiness in Zaheer and Ashraf's lives. A nasty attack during the celebrations leads Zaheer to take the brave decision of quitting the underworld.

videos.title: The Naked Truce
videos.overview: When Nana Mhatre plans to take a revenge, Maqsood spreads a smart trap for Zaheer.

videos.title: The Big Hunt
videos.overview: Inspector Tawde plays dirty and Zaheer fights back hard. But finally, Nana Mhatre kills Zaheer brutally. Ashraf gets the biggest shock of her life.

videos.title: The Turmoil
videos.overview: Devastated Ashraf decides to fight back. A journalist exposes inspector Tawde and Bhoir in a big way. Inspector Tawde comes to know about the connection between Ashraf and Anjali.

videos.title: The Defeat
videos.overview: Ashraf tries to fight back. But due to the nexus between these gang lords and corrupt politicians, Ashraf faces the defeat in the court and the only eye witness gets arrested.

videos.title: The Transformation
videos.overview: Ashraf tries to make a syndicate against a common enemy. But he denies the collaboration. She decides to take revenge herself and joins a dance bar as a dancer. In the whole new world, she gets her new identity, Sapna.

videos.title: The Honey Trap
videos.overview: Sapna's magic starts working on Sawtya, a sharp shooter from Nana Mhatre gang. Ashraf instigates him to open a wild firing on Tawde and Bhoir creating animosity between Nana Mhatre gang and Tawde.

videos.title: The Taste Of Blood
videos.overview: Ashraf takes her first brutal move on Bhoir in the hospital and has planned something unexpected and ruthless for Sawtya. But unfortunately Ashraf's plan fails and puts her in a miserable condition.

videos.title: The Game Becomes Ugly
videos.overview: Ashraf gets out of the difficult situation and the first face off with Nana Mhatre happens. Bala Mama comes to know about the real identity of Sapna. Ashraf uses this to her advantage.

videos.title: The Ultimate Seduction
videos.overview: Ashraf crosses all the boundaries to attract and seduce Nana Mhatre and becomes very close to him. She gives tip off as Sapna to Vikram Bhosle about Nana's drug consignment. Now Ashraf is getting ready to play the bigger game.

videos.title: The Big Catch
videos.overview: Ashraf reaches up to the home minister, Ganpatrao Kadamand tips off Vikram about the huge stock of drugs at his farm house. Vikram raids the place. Finally, when Vikram raids Nana Mhatre's house, he is shocked to see Ashraf there.

videos.title: The Countdown Begins
videos.overview: Nana gets arrested by Vikram. But he notices the connection between Vikram and Sapna. The home minister gets exposed in media. After getting a bail, Nana threatens Vikram that he will kill Sapna brutally.

videos.title: The Final Encounter
videos.overview: Ashraf plans to eliminate Maqsood. A big encounter happens at the docks. Nana gets seriously injured in the attack. Finally, unknown men attacks Ashraf at her home brutally.

videos.title: Re-Birth
videos.overview: Strangers attack Ashraf, but she survives. Vikram declares her deceased. When Ashraf recuperates, she flees police custody by escaping the safehouse without leaving a trace. Ashraf meets Rashid and changes her identity.

videos.title: Game of Power
videos.overview: Ashraf gets a new identity and the cops detain her. The disunity between Yashwant Patil, the new CM, and Shaqeel Ansari begins with a stalled business deal. Ashwin Surve takes on the established gangs of Maqsood and Bhai Chavan.

videos.title: Face-Off
videos.overview: Ashraf retrieves her file. ACP Qureshi re-enlists Vikram in his search for Ashraf. ACM Patil teams up with Ashwin Surve to take out BMC officer Khardikar. Ashwin comes across Leela Paswan, after eliminating Khardikar.

videos.title: Muscle Meets Brain
videos.overview: Nari Khan agrees to supply drugs to Ashwin. Shaqeel Ansari is openly challenged by CM Patil. Shaqeel forces Nari Khan into betraying Ashwin Surve and cutting off his supply. Ashraf arrives at Ashwin's house with a business proposition.

videos.title: Hunters Hunt
videos.overview: Ashwin has faith in Leela Paswan and gives her money to buy drugs. Ashraf is abducted by Jaggi Biswa. Ashraf meets Ugri, a bright village girl who assists her in fleeing. Ashraf murders Jaggi Biswa in the heat of the moment.

videos.title: Biggest Deal
videos.overview: Ashraf strikes a deal, reserving the entire Marijuana crop planted in the village. Ashraf returns to Bombay and manages to elude the police. Vardha Pillai becomes increasingly concerned about Ashraf's growing influence over Ashwin.

videos.title: Meeting the Devil
videos.overview: Ashwin's gang seizes control of the Bombay drug trade. Shaqeel Ansari accepts the proposition of the CM and joins hands with him. Maqsood hires Leela and Ashwin as his employees. Vikram receives information about a drug peddler and Ashraf.

videos.title: The Game Begins
videos.overview: Nana Mhatre meets Vardha Pillai and discovers that Leela Paswan is Ashraf Bhatkar. Vikram is successful in breaking down Ashwin's drug cartel. CM persuades the cops to leave him alone. Vardha notifies Ashwin of Leela's true identity.

videos.title: A Deadly Encounter
videos.overview: Anita informs Ashraf of the plot against her. Shaqeel Ansari arrives to save her and eliminates Vardha Pillai. Ashraf kills her arch-enemy Nana Mhatre. Ashwin meets with an accident. Ashraf is successful in gaining Shaqeel's trust.

videos.title: Shadows of Past
videos.overview: Ashwin survives the accident, but he is unable to speak or move. Ashraf pushes Nari Khan aside and secretly begins supplying drugs to Maqsood's gang. Anita seizes control of the gang. Ashraf begins to prepare for the final confrontation.

videos.title: Brutal Truth
videos.overview: learn the truth about Leela's true identity. Anita is about to kill Ashraf when Bhai Chavan launches an attack on Ashwin's gang. Anita gets killed in the encounter. Ashraf manages to flee.

videos.title: The Final Chapter
videos.overview: Ashraf becomes the Bombay police's most wanted criminal. Shaqeel decides to cancel his travel plans. Ashraf strikes Shaqeel in order to kill him. The confrontation between Maqsood and Ashraf occurs, and it ends violently.
